title: Abbas na jao ruk jao
body:
Jab Ran Ko Chalay Khaimay Se Abbas e Delawar
Sab Bibiyan Lipti The Sambhaly Howy Chader
Hathon Se Kamar Tham Ke Pas Aye Jo Sarwar
Bosa Leya Abbas Ke Shanon Ka Yay Keh kar
Tum Jesa Barader Main Kahan Paonga Bhai
Tum loat Kay Na Aye Tu Mar Jaonga Bhai
Senay Se Laga Kar Shah Ne Kaha Abbas Na Jao Ruk Jao Aye Bhai Na Jao Ruk Jao
Koi Bhe Nahi Hai Ab Mera Abbas Na Jao Ruk Jao Aye Bhai Na Jao Ruk Jao
1) Bolo To Sakina Ko Main Samjha Dnga Abbas
Mashkiza Mujhe Dedo Main Louta Donga Abbas
Shikwa Na Karyge Pani Ka
Rakh Degi Wo Hathon Se Koza
Wo Kehna Nahi Talyge Mera
<<MINI>>
Abbas Na Jao Ruk Jao
<<DIVIDER>>
2) Thehro Ke Tmhain Dylon Main Jeny Ke Duain
Tm Mar Gaye To Kon Bachayega Ridain
Dharas Hai Tmhe Se Zainab Ko
Ja Ja Kay Batati Hai Sab Ko
Zinda Hai Abhe Ghazi Mera
<<MINI>>
Abbas Na Jao Ruk Jao
<<DIVIDER>>
3) Maidan Main Kis Tarha Tmhain Jane Do Bolo
Akbar Ke Tarha Pala Hai Is Bhai Ne Tum ko
Jo Ran Ko Gaya Wo Na Aya
Tum Bhe Na Agar Aye Bhaiya
Main Kesy Uthaonga Lasha
<<MINI>>
Abbas Na Jao Ruk Jao
<<DIVIDER>>
4) Ruktay He Na Thay Zainab o Kulsoom Kay Anson
Jab Shah Ne Kaha Choom Ke Abbas Ke Bazo
Yay Shanain Qalam Na Hojain
Be Asra Hum Na Hojain
Yay Bazo Sahara Hai Sab Ka
<<MINI>>
Abbas Na Jao Ruk Jao
<<DIVIDER>>
5) Wo Kofa Wo Zarbat Main Kahan Bhola Hon Abbas
Tum Akhri Baba Ke Nishani Ho Mery Pas
Yaad Ati Hai Jab Bhe Baba Ke
Main Dekhta Hon Tum Ko Ghazi
Zakhmi Na Ho Baba Ka Chehra
<<MINI>>
Abbas Na Jao Ruk Jao
<<DIVIDER>>
6) Behain Na Mery Sath Agar Hoti Alamdar
Khud Tum Ko Larai Kay Leyay Karta Main Tayar
Yan War Karogy Tum Jitne
Har War Ka Teri Behnon Se
Bazaar Main Lain Gay Wo Badla
<<MINI>>
Abbas Na Jao Ruk Jao
<<DIVIDER>>
7) Zeeshan o Raza Kesa Tha Ghurbat Ka Wo Manzar
Bhai Kay Qadam Chom Kay Mashkiza Utha Kar
Abbas Jo Niklay Khaimon Se
Girti The Ridain Khud Sar Se Aur Kehty Rahy Shah e Wala
<<MINI>>
Abbas Na Jao Ruk Jao
